title: Amazon’s Panos Panay to Discuss the Future of Hardware Beyond Smartphones at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
summary: Amazon’s SVP of Devices and Services, Panos Panay, will speak at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 about the evolution of hardware in a post-smartphone era. With AI integration reshaping device ecosystems, Panay—who previously led Microsoft’s Surface and Windows 11 development—will share insights on Amazon’s vision, including advancements in Alexa+ and potential new form factors like AI assistants and smart glasses. The discussion will explore how hardware may shift from smartphone-centric designs to more immersive, AI-driven experiences.
key_points: Panos Panay, Amazon’s SVP of Devices and Services, will speak at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 about the next generation of hardware beyond smartphones.
